## Activity

During July 2019, Market Eye Clinic completed 359 captures. Activity was delivered in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other operational issues were reported. The volume of completed captures provides the basis for the image quality and grading results recorded for the month.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 21 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.8. The result should be monitored through routine review of capture practice and session performance. Where images cannot be graded, repeat capture or other appropriate follow-up may be required in accordance with local arrangements.

## Grading

A total of 56 results were graded referable during July 2019. The median grading wait was 1 days. This measure should be considered alongside the activity level and the proportion of ungradable images when reviewing the service. Overall, the site maintained planned session activity, with the reported results providing a clear summary of throughput, image quality and grading performance for the month.
